heading: Speed of vessel in ice region

tree.heading: Requirement.—
tree.text: The master of a vessel of the United States, when ice is reported on or near the vessel’s course, shall proceed at a moderate speed or change the course of the vessel to go well clear of the danger zone.

tree.heading: Civil Penalty.—
tree.text: A master violating this section is liable to the United States Government for a civil penalty of not more than $500.
